dedupe_keys.name: synthetic low voltage networks and demand scenarios for public ev charging station location and grid expansion planning

description: A KU Leuven researcher publishes synthetic low-voltage network and charging-demand inputs for postal area 80803. Zenodo provides two CC BY 4.0 archives for twenty and fifty-five percent EV-penetration scenarios. The record identifies PowerModels.jl-compatible grid files, base-load and EV-use scenarios, charger types, distance matrices and mapping geodata. The grid was generated with Pylovo, while EV demand uses Emobpy. These inputs can test joint charging-site and network-expansion models. No related catalogue record explicitly covers these paired scenarios. Coverage is one synthetic postal-area case, not surveyed distribution feeders or observed charging choices. A limitation is that siting results depend on assumed user demand, charger technology and electrical constraints, and may differ on a real feeder. No archive was downloaded, load-flow model run or charging-site result reproduced.
